title: Complement closure of polynomial time
statement: For every binary language $L$, if $L$ is decidable by a finite deterministic Turing machine in polynomial time, then its complement is also decidable in polynomial time.
replaced:
Let $L \subseteq \{0,1\}^{*}$ be a language decidable in polynomial time, i.e.\
$L \in \mathsf{P}$. Then its complement $\overline{L} = \{0,1\}^{*} \setminus L$ is
also in $\mathsf{P}$.
